question_text: Construct a UML class-relationship diagram for ChilledItem, Item and Shop. ChilledItem is a subclass of Item. Shop stores references to Items that exist independently and may be moved to another Shop; omit attributes/methods.
adaptation_rationale: Retains relationship diagram; explicit independent life time makes aggregation unambiguous.

marking_points.criterion: Generalization arrow with hollow triangle pointing from ChilledItem toward Item.
Aggregation relationship with hollow diamond at Shop linking to Item.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct wording or valid implementation earning the specified independent points.
partial_credit_notes: Award each stated point independently up to the total; do not double-credit the same idea.

verification.technical: Concrete marking points independently reasoned from the defined context and exact 2027 scope.
verification.code_check: No executable code required; manual technical check.
